tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Future Technology Devices International (FTDI) USB Serial Port (commonly FT232R USB UART). It is a widely used USB-to-serial adapter, frequently utilized in Arduino boards, industrial equipment, and USB-to-RS232/RS-485 converters.

Upgrade your connectivity with the reliable Z-TEK USB-to-RS232/RS-485 Converter, now available at OTECH BD. Designed for industrial, commercial, and professional applications, this high-performance USB to Serial converter ensures stable and fast communication between modern computers and legacy serial devices.


Whether you need to connect PLCs, industrial machines, POS systems, modems, or networking equipment, Z-TEK converters deliver secure and efficient data transmission with wide OS compatibility.


Key Features:

  • USB 2.0 to RS-232 / RS-485 / RS-422 Serial Interface
  • High-Speed Data Transmission
  • Industrial-Grade Build Quality
  • Stable Chipset for Reliable Communication
  • Plug and Play (Driver Support for Windows, Linux, Mac)
  • Supports Long-Distance Communication (RS-485)
  • Compact & Durable Design
